evaluations.reason: [REQ:R6] requires null-currentTaskId/actionable-task impl review to fail before subprocess without an audited broad-mode record, succeed as broad only with a matching non-empty broadModeHistory reason, and enforce runId/Issue/spec mismatches as ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH before scope resolution or mutation. The diff implements this in [TARGET:3] by resolving null-cursor actionable work to blocked unless latestBroadModeRecord(state, "impl-review") exists, preserving broadModeHistory/BROAD_STEPS, and in [TARGET:2] returns taskCursorRequiredReviewFailure before precheck, stop-state clear, or subprocess; it only calls assertAuditedBroadMode for broad decisions, which rejects empty reasons. The R6 spec-local test in [FILE-MAP:R6:1] covers no-broad failure with no subprocess/no broad audit, empty-reason failure with no subprocess/no mutation, broad success exposing unchanged broadMode.reason, matching guards proceeding to scope resolution/subprocess, and runId/Issue/spec mismatches returning ACTIVE_FLOW_MISMATCH with no scope resolution or subprocess. [AC:7] and [AC:8] are also satisfied by the added spec-local header `// spec: R1 R2 R3 R4 R5 R6`, focused R6 pass evidence in `specs/325-fix-flow-review-scope/test-execute-result.json`, production changes limited to [TARGET:2] and [TARGET:3], and no dependency/allowlist additions shown in the diff; related/base failures are recorded as follow-up candidates in `specs/325-fix-flow-review-scope/issue-log.json` without expanding the requirement.
